column1: # Measure gates for ltra2_2_line (validation-manifest contract: measures).
# Why measures: the LTRA convolution kernel is pinned to <1e-6 against
# replay), but the mV-scale post-edge tails of this two-stage deck are
# chaotic amplifications of sub-reltol Newton differences through the
# convolution memory: ngspice-46's own tail values move 22-52 percent
# when tmax is refined 2-8x, and RSpice's fine-step values match
# ngspice's fine-step values to ~0.05 percent. Pointwise tail samples
# therefore measure grid reproduction, not physics. These gates assert
# the engineering content: edge timing through both line stages and
# settled logic levels, with 50 mV (1 percent of the 5 V swing) level
# floors that still fail on any real level error.
# Source: VS pulses 0->5 V at 15.9 ns (0.2 ns edges), falls at 31.9 ns.
# v(2) = first driver output (inverts VS), v(3) = far end of line 1,
# v(4) = second driver output (inverts v(3)), v(5) = far end of line 2.
# Line delay TD = sqrt(L*C)*len = 1.037 ns per stage.
